candidate_source_binding: the additive A/B/C count-18 primitive, gdn_core_fused_v1 kernel, fixed-shape bridge, Rust selectors and receipts, gate example, tests, custody closure, and this predeclaration must be committed and pushed together before the first candidate performance sample

scope.stage: independent count-matched primitive mechanism screen only; a pass authorizes a separate explicit production-topology continuation gate and does not accept or default an end-to-end runtime
scope.model_shape: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B GDN core at the 18 production linear-attention layers

independence_from_rejected_qk_staged_pro.rejected_candidate_scope: qk-staged changed only the recurrent kernel implementation and thread geometry while retaining the four-dispatch depthwise-preprocess, Q/K-normalize, recurrent-update, and norm-gate sequence at every seam
independence_from_rejected_qk_staged_pro.new_candidate_scope: gdn_core_fused_v1 combines those four dependent kernels into one per-head fused kernel dispatch at every seam
independence_from_rejected_qk_staged_pro.material_difference: four kernels become one kernel; this is a dispatch-and-barrier topology change, not another recurrent-local-reuse variant
independence_from_rejected_qk_staged_pro.qualification: 72-to-18 dispatch and barrier counts are precommitted source/bridge/runtime-receipt expectations for the count-18 primitive, not hardware performance counters
independence_from_rejected_qk_staged_pro.B_control_disposition: the additive qk-staged primitive remains feasible in the independent diagnostic library and is retained only as a four-dispatch control; rejected production plumbing must not be restored

A.role: authoritative legacy arithmetic and topology baseline

B.role: feasible retained additive control that isolates fusion benefit from previously accepted recurrent-local reuse; never a fallback or renewed production candidate

C.mapping: one threadgroup owns one fixed Q/K/V value head, performs depthwise convolution, legacy-order Q/K normalization, recurrent update, and norm gate with explicit internal phase barriers

fixed_arithmetic_contract.loop_carried_recurrent_delta_is_volatile: required to preserve the legacy kernel's per-key F32 materialization/contraction result to bits in the larger fused compiler context
fixed_arithmetic_contract.gated_output_loop_remains_single_thread_: required because parallel per-lane writes changed backend contraction by one ULP despite identical inputs

count18_aggregate_topology_per_successfu.barrier_qualification: A/B place one explicit broad buffer barrier after each of four stage dispatches per seam; C places one symmetric broad consumer barrier after each fused seam dispatch; fused internal threadgroup barriers are separately source- and pipeline-attested
count18_aggregate_topology_per_successfu.zero_copy_qualification: zero explicit bridge memcpy inside the timed aggregate call, not zero GPU, cache, shared-memory, or unified-memory traffic

fixed_fixture.generator: deterministic independently seeded dyadic xorshift64 streams; every input and expected tensor is fingerprinted from little-endian f32 bits with domain and shape tags
fixed_fixture.branch_coverage: fixtures must cover negative and nonnegative beta inputs including negative zero, and all three softplus branches below -20, inclusive [-20,20], and above 20
fixed_fixture.signed_zero_sentinels: fixed +0.0 and -0.0 locations in projected, convolution-state, recurrent-state, coefficient, and norm-weight domains

conv_exactness.processed_values_are_not_separately_obse: C deliberately avoids global processed output; normalized Q/K arithmetic is qualified transitively by exact recurrent state and gated outputs

recurrent_exactness.core_is_not_separately_observed: C deliberately keeps core in threadgroup memory; exact gated output plus exact recurrent state closes the externally observable contract

fixed_performance_schedule.position_balance: each arm occupies each cell position 1 through 6 exactly once across the three timed blocks
fixed_performance_schedule.timing: host monotonic elapsed time around one complete synchronous count-18 aggregate GPU call; staging, poisoning, snapshots, exactness checks, input verification, custody checks, statistics, and JSON work are outside timing
fixed_performance_schedule.primary_statistic: even median of raw aggregate-call latency per arm in each block and pooled
fixed_performance_schedule.start_admission: argument and create-new path validation, embedded candidate binding, clean local/origin/live-GitHub custody, disk-versus-embedded source hashes, legacy production-consumer selection, fixture construction and coverage, primitive creation, and zero-run A/B/C receipts must pass before the one candidate execution; a failure in this admission phase performs no correctness or performance call, creates no raw receipt, and is not a sampling retry
fixed_performance_schedule.failure_policy: after start admission, on any correctness, runtime-receipt, end-custody, or sampled-call failure, publish the create-new raw or partial receipt and reject without retry, replacement, resampling, or a second performance run

precommitted_admission.equality_behavior: pooled equality at 3.0 percent and 8.0 percent passes; a block improvement of exactly 0.0 percent is not positive
precommitted_admission.overall_pass: full A/B/C bit exactness and input immutability AND fixed-shape and invalid-selector admission AND exact runtime topology receipts AND completed fixed three-block schedule AND both pooled thresholds AND both comparisons strictly positive in every block AND unchanged custody AND zero sampled failures
precommitted_admission.pass_authorizes: retain only the additive primitive evidence and begin a separately predeclared explicit opt-in production-topology continuation gate for gdn_core_fused_v1
precommitted_admission.failure_action: after an admitted candidate execution fails, archive the create-new raw receipt and rejection summary, then revert candidate implementation while retaining this predeclaration and rejection evidence

cross_runtime_rule.omniinfer_rule: no OmniInfer refresh before explicit full-path acceptance; any later omnimind-ai/OmniInfer result must separate llama.cpp core timing from gateway/orchestration wall time
